name: Külsősárd (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Külsősárd: a blue shield with a white arm holding a sabre and a red rose, with a helm, a crown, a crest and red, blue and yellow mantling, above a scroll inscribed KÜLSŐSÁRD.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Külsősárd arms with helm, crown, crest, mantling and scroll
